description: Store a durable memory under a key you choose, so you can recall it in a future session. The value is text (notes, JSON, state, or URLs pointing to your own files) and is private to you. Overwrites an existing memory with the same key.

key.description: Key to store this memory under (letters, digits, and . _ : -).
key.title: Key

value.description: The memory content: text, JSON, notes, or URLs to your own files.
value.title: Value
